statements.impact_statement: Narrowly scoped to the exact Red Hat OpenJDK RPM PURL and version observed in quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.2. Red Hat states that RHEL OpenJDK RPMs do not contain a private CA bundle and use the system ca-certificates package; Red Hat does not issue an OpenJDK fix for CVE-2026-91403 because the attempted upstream intermediate-certificate blocklist was insufficient. The actual system trust-store removal is tracked as CVE-2026-114406. This image contains ca-certificates 2026.2.92_v9.0.319-90.3.el9_8, the exact RHEL 9 package published in RHSA-2026:88459. A keytool inventory of the JRE cacerts in this image showed only emsignrootca-g1 among the matching aliases; the compromised Comodo AAA Services and emSign ECC Root CA G3 roots listed in the Red Hat bulletin were not present. This statement does not cover Red Hat build-of-OpenJDK products that bundle their own trust store, other Java builds, or other image versions. Evidence: CI run 42231828253 package inventory and Java trust-store inspection; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-91403; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-114406; https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026:88459; https://access.redhat.com/security/vulnerabilities/RHSB-2026-012
